dct_title_s: Landslide/mudslide Impact in Mai Mahiu  and Kijabe Towns, Kenya as of 1 May 2024
dct_description_sm: **UNOSAT code: FL20240426KEN, GDACS ID: 1102561** This map illustrates satellite-detected landslides in Mai Mahiu and Kijabe Towns, Kenya, as observed from a Pléiades image acquired on 1 May 2024 at 11:06 local time (08:06 UTC). Within the analyzed area, about 2 km² of landslide scars with a total length of 10 km were observed. UNITAR-UNOSAT identified 1,338 affected structures, about 10 km of affected roads, 2 damaged bridges, and 1 damaged railway. This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to the United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT).
